description:
Partner Hub

Join Our Affiliate Program and Level Up Your Earnings!

Welcome to The Home Of Gaming Affiliate Program – where gaming enthusiasts and content creators can turn their passion into profits! We're excited to invite you to join our affiliate family and unlock a world of exclusive benefits.

Why Become an Affiliate?

1. Generous Commissions:

  • Earn competitive commissions on every sale made through your unique affiliate link.

2. Exclusive Discounts for Your Audience:

  • Provide your audience with special discounts on our cutting-edge gaming products, making your content even more appealing.

3. Freebies and Giveaways:

  • Gain access to free products, giveaways, and exclusive promotions to share with your audience, boosting engagement.

4. Extended Cookie Duration:

  • Benefit from a generous cookie duration, ensuring you get credited for sales even if they occur beyond the initial click.

5. Collaborative Campaigns:

  • Participate in creative marketing campaigns and collaborations, elevating your content and engaging your audience in exciting ways.

How to Apply:

Ready to kick off this exciting partnership? Applying is easy!

  1. Send us a Message:

    • Simply email us at thehomeofgaming01@gmail.com expressing your interest in joining our affiliate program.

  2. Include Your Details:

    • Tell us a bit about yourself, your audience, and why you're excited to collaborate with The Home Of Gaming.

  3. Get the Details:

    • Once we receive your email, we'll provide you with all the details you need to get started.

Join The Home Of Gaming Affiliate Program today and turn your gaming passion into earnings! We can't wait to welcome you to the team.

Happy gaming!

The Home Of Gaming Team 🎮🚀

Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

These Terms and Conditions ("Agreement") are entered into by and between "The Home Of Gaming" ("Company") and the individual or entity ("Affiliate") participating in the affiliate program.

1. Enrollment:

  • Affiliates must apply and be approved before participating in the affiliate program.
  • The Company reserves the right to reject or terminate any affiliate at its discretion.

2. Commission Structure:

  • Affiliates earn a commission on qualifying sales made through their unique affiliate link.
  • The standard commission rate is 10%, subject to change at the Company's discretion.
  • Tiered commission structures may apply for affiliates who consistently drive higher sales.

3. Payouts:

  • Commissions are paid monthly.
  • Payouts are processed within 30 days after the end of each calendar month.
  • Minimum payout thresholds may apply.

4. Cookie Duration:

  • Affiliates are credited for sales generated within 30 days of the initial click on their affiliate link.

5. Compliance:

  • Affiliates must comply with all applicable laws and regulations.
  • Affiliates are prohibited from engaging in any form of deceptive or misleading marketing practices.

6. Termination:

  • The Company reserves the right to terminate an affiliate for any violation of these terms or for conduct detrimental to the Company.
  • Either party may terminate this agreement at any time with written notice.

7. Promotional Methods:

  • Affiliates are encouraged to use ethical and honest promotional methods.
  • Prohibited methods include spam, false advertising, and any activities that may damage the Company's reputation.

8. Confidentiality:

  • Affiliates agree to keep confidential any information shared by the Company, including but not limited to commission rates and terms.

9. Changes to Terms:

  • The Company reserves the right to update or modify these terms at any time.
  • Affiliates will be notified of any changes, and continued participation implies acceptance of the modified terms.

10. Governing Law: - This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of [Jurisdiction], without regard to its conflict of law principles.

By participating in the affiliate program, the Affiliate acknowledges that they have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.
